parts.name: Dissipative Dual Layer Rubber Mat Top Kit
parts.description: Blue dual-layer rubber ESD work surface mat kit with a dissipative top layer and a conductive bottom layer, supplied with a 15’ common point ground cord, screws, snap, washer, label, conical nut and a bottle of ESD surface and mat cleaner.
features: Dissipative (1 x 106 to <1 x 109 ohms Rtt) top layer
Heat, chemical, and oil absorption resistance
Kit includes dissipative dual layer ESD work surface, 15’ common point ground cord, screws (2), snap, washer, label, conical nut, and bottle of ESD surface and mat cleaner

specs.Ground Cord Material: High flex strand copper, 20 gauge, With PVC insulated jacket

parts.notes: Sold as a kit (mat, 15’ ground cord, 2 screws, snap, washer, label, conical nut, ESD cleaner bottle). Row is badged F and M (fractional and metric). Resistance values are printed as '1 x 106' / '1 x 109' (no visible superscript); presumably 1 x 10^6 and 1 x 10^9 ohms.

page_notes.758: Accessories 9-60: Dissipative Dual Layer Rubber Mat Top Kit, one table row (12337, badged F and M).
